claim_being_audited: That the current release can be certified as policy-compliant on the present record, based on aggregate readiness plus documentation and monitoring context.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses must be disclosed before launch unless resolved or covered by approved mitigation or risk acceptance.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring comments may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed acceptance.
Aggregate readiness evidence helps support launch readiness but does not by itself satisfy the disclosure predicate for certification.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release documentation or model card showing the present evaluation results, including the cybersecurity alert triage regression.
Provide approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance covering the below-threshold cybersecurity alert triage segment.
Provide evidence that the identified segment weakness is disclosed in the launch documentation for the named use case.
Provide the final certification packet or approval artifact tying the current release, current eval batch, and current retrieval configuration to the required disclosures or mitigation.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results, but no admissible evidence shows that the documentation has been updated.
The cybersecurity alert triage slice is below the warning threshold, and no approved mitigation or risk acceptance is attached.
The policy requires material segment weaknesses to be disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation before certification may proceed.
The release-thread monitoring comment is informal context only and does not satisfy the policy requirement for reviewed mitigation, acceptance, or disclosure.
Prior approval of the same model family predates the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot carry the current release.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently supportable on the existing record.
That the documentation-dependent condition has already been satisfied.
That informal post-launch monitoring can substitute for approved mitigation or current disclosure support.
